item.description:

item.title: Latin Fridays & Saturdays at Lula Lounge — Sat Oct 10, 8:00 PM — Lula Lounge
item.description:

item.title: Production-Grade Agents: Evaluation, Tracing, Security, and Operations — Thu Oct 15, 11:00 AM
item.description:
Microsoft Reactor Toronto A successful demonstration does not prove that an agent is ready for production. Production readiness requires measurable quality, end-to-end observability, repeatable testing, controlled releases, and a clear operational model.
In the final session, we will evaluate and operate the agent solution built throughout the series. We will create a representative evaluation dataset covering normal requests, ambiguous cases, tool failures, unauthorized actions, outdated knowledge, and prompt-injection attempts.
Using Microsoft Foundry evaluation and observability capabilities, we will measure task completion, tool-call accuracy, groundedness, relevance, latency, safety, and operational reliability. We will trace requests across the agent, API Management, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, and the worker application using distributed tracing and Application Insights.

Let’s hit the road for another Doors Open adventure! We’ll be heading to beautiful **Doors Open Niagara-on-the-Lake** to explore historic buildings, cultural sites, and hidden spaces that are rarely open to the public. Nick has been a **Doors Open Toronto volunteer for over two decades**, and he always enjoys checking out Doors Open events in other cities. item.title: De Profundis: Oscar Wilde in Jail — Tue Nov 3, 7:30 PM — Soulpepper Theatre
item.description:
“There is no prison in any world into which love cannot force an entrance.”
This November, Soulpepper Theatre is thrilled to bring back their award-winning musical adaptation of DE PROFUNDIS: OSCAR WILDE IN JAIL
The musical begins with Oscar Wilde languishing in a prison cell, cut off from the world that once adored him. As he writes a letter to the man he loved—memory, regret, and desire crowd the silence—turning confinement into confession.
In this intimate, 90-minute musical fantasy, Robbie Ross and Bosie emerge through Wilde’s fractured memories as as the plot thickens and audience are carried away by the original, genre-spanning score that moves from Irish ballads to Broadway and electro-pop.
Weaving together Wilde’s trial testimonies, letters and epigrams, De Profundis reveals Wilde unmasked: lover, icon and exile—insisting that even in the darkest places, love can still reach us.
Onstage at Soulpepper Theatre for a limited run from November 3rd- November 29th

Then sew the embroidery into a small lavender sachet to create your own pleasant lightly scented piece. Along the way, participants will gain confidence with basic embroidery techniques and hand-sewing skills. All teens are welcome! Drop-in, no registration required. This program is part of Youth Hub service. Youth Hubs are a welcoming place for teens after school and in the summer, where helpful staff are always available. Free, nutritious snacks are offered daily. Drop by a branch with a Youth Hub or call the branch to find out more.
Source: Toronto Public Library — Teens

item.title: De Profundis: Oscar Wilde in Jail — Wed Nov 11, 7:30 PM — Soulpepper Theatre
item.description:
“There is no prison in any world into which love cannot force an entrance.”
This November, Soulpepper Theatre is thrilled to bring back their award-winning musical adaptation of DE PROFUNDIS: OSCAR WILDE IN JAIL
The musical begins with Oscar Wilde languishing in a prison cell, cut off from the world that once adored him. As he writes a letter to the man he loved—memory, regret, and desire crowd the silence—turning confinement into confession.
In this intimate, 90-minute musical fantasy, Robbie Ross and Bosie emerge through Wilde’s fractured memories as as the plot thickens and audience are carried away by the original, genre-spanning score that moves from Irish ballads to Broadway and electro-pop.
Weaving together Wilde’s trial testimonies, letters and epigrams, De Profundis reveals Wilde unmasked: lover, icon and exile—insisting that even in the darkest places, love can still reach us.
Onstage at Soulpepper Theatre for a limited run from November 3rd- November 29th
